_note: Owner-approved compartment answers for the sofa lines still on a bare -1S placeholder on PROCEEDED company-1 orders, 2026-09-04. Same shape as sofa-compartment-corrections-2026-08.json. Every entry names the documents it applies to, the model, the target piece list, the seat where the book or the slip states one, the desc2Match that tells one build on a document from another, and a why recording how the answer was reached. Four entries are the owner's own reading, given in chat; the rest are read off the photograph and confirmed by him. 2026-09-08: HC-SO-013475 was added to this same file rather than a new one - a fourth file whose name also contains "2026-09" would make the FILE= substring filter select two rounds at once (scripts/lib/sofa-corrections-source.test.mjs pins that), and this build carries its own why, which is where the evidence has to live. It is NOT a placeholder build: it is the shop floor reporting that the drawing and our decode disagree. 2026-09-08 ROUND 2: 16 more builds, all of them the owner's OWN words given in chat while he read his slips one by one. They are appended to THIS file rather than a new one for the reason the previous sentence gives - a fourth file whose name also contains "2026-09" would make the FILE= substring filter select two rounds at once, which scripts/lib/sofa-corrections-source.test.mjs pins. Two of them (HC-SO-012827) are matched on the account book's own LINE KEY rather than on text, because the book wrote one line's Desc2 as a substring of the other's and no needle can tell them apart.
_rules: Money never moves: the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0. Lines are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place so a row id - and any purchase allocation hanging off it - survives. A document can hold MORE THAN ONE sofa build, so desc2Match is required; where a document holds TWO lines with the SAME text those are two identical sofas and both take the build.
